description: Read UTF-8 file bytes within this room's granted roots and return their content hash for an exact subsequent file.write. For JSON, select only needed fields with json_pointers; the hash always covers the complete original file, so a patch needs no full record in context.

path.description: Absolute path under this room's granted roots.

json_pointers.description: Optional RFC 6901 pointers, e.g. /ee or /interface_state. Returns selected values keyed by pointer instead of full content, with the complete file's content_hash and byte count. Empty array returns only metadata; empty string selects the whole JSON value. Missing or malformed pointers fail. Omit for full UTF-8 text.
